title: Find a teammate and attack space
outcome: Players recognize when to carry the ball, when a teammate offers a better route and how to attack a less crowded goal.

fourCorners.technical: players receive a passed ball and carry it into open space
fourCorners.physical: players accelerate into space they've found before a defender closes it
fourCorners.psychological: players decide between dribbling and passing under pressure, and trust their choice
fourCorners.social: players move to be seen by a teammate and read when to combine with them

coach_cues: Where can your teammate see you?
What did the defender leave open?
Can you switch to another goal?

activities.variation: Revisit 2v1 over either end line; both passing and dribbling remain valid.
Attack two goals and read the defender rather than requiring a pass.
activities.setup_note: Same two 2v1 fields as find-a-friend; widen them slightly and add a mini goal at each far end.

progression.note: First half. Coach-managed restarts; rotate the goalkeeper.
Second half, same setup. Switch ends; rotate anyone who hasn't played every role.
